question: What mass of odor does a young woman destroy by anointing the body in summer?
premises: A young woman anoints the body in summer.
She destroys the mass of bad-smelling sweat moisture.
inference: Summer anointing removes accumulated sweaty odor.
uncertainties: The anointing substance is not named in this verse.
plain_english: A young woman, having anointed the body in summer, destroys the mass of bad-smelling sweat moisture.
